turns.q: For a 1.4 crore flat in Noida, what is the total cost including stamp duty, registration and GST?
turns.answer:
### On ₹1.40 Cr

| Charge | Amount |
| :--- | ---: |
| Stamp duty (7%) | **₹9,80,000** |
| Stamp duty if a woman is primary owner (6%) | ₹8,40,000 |
| Registration (1%) | ₹1,40,000 |
| GST if under construction (5%) | ₹7,00,000 |
| GST if ready to move with OC | ₹0 |
| **Total, ready to move** | **₹1,51,20,000** |
| **Total, under construction** | **₹1,58,20,000** |

Stamp duty is charged on the agreement value or the circle rate, whichever is higher, so the figure above is the floor. You also deduct 1% TDS (₹1,40,000) from the payment to the seller and deposit it with Form 26QB.

### Statutory taxes & registration charges (Uttar Pradesh)

These are set by law and are the same for every project.

| Component | Rate | Nature | Paid when & to whom |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stamp duty** | 7% of agreement or circle value, whichever is higher | Mandatory | At registry, to the UP Stamp & Registration Department |
| **Stamp duty — female primary owner** | 6% | Concession | At registry |
| **Registration fee** | 1% of value | Mandatory | At deed execution, to the Sub-Registrar |
| **GST — under construction** | 5% (without input tax credit) | Statutory | Billed across construction milestones |
| **GST — ready to move with OC** | 0% | Exempt | Not applicable once the Occupancy Certificate is granted |
| **TDS (Section 194-IA)** | 1% of sale consideration | Mandatory | Deducted by the buyer when value exceeds ₹50 Lakh (Form 26QB) |

### Budgeting
Allow 12–14% above base price for an under-construction home, or 8–9% above base price for ready-to-move with OC, to cover statutory and possession charges — typical for Noida — not verified for this project.

Name a project and I'll use whichever of its own charges we hold verified.

turns.q: Is Sector 150 good for families?

Prominent projects with family-focused 3BHK+ layouts include **Mahagun Meadows** (Ready to Move) alongside **ACE Parkway**, **Tata Eureka Park Phase 2**, and **Eldeco Live By The Greens Phase 2** (Under Construction).The primary trade-off for families today is livability maturity: while school bus networks cover the area, core social infrastructure like mega-malls, everyday retail markets, and major hospital operational hubs are still developing, requiring short drives along the Noida-Expressway. turns.q: What are the biggest risks I should check before buying a flat in Noida?
turns.answer:
Buying a flat in Noida involves navigating specific regulatory and financial risks. Here are the critical items to verify before signing:* **Authority Dues Clearance:** A society No Dues Certificate (NDC) only covers maintenance, not the builder's land dues with the local authority. Without an Authority land dues clearance, your individual sub-lease deed registration remains blocked even after possession.
Registration puts the project on record with the authority and gives you a route to complain; it is not a warranty on delivery, title or build quality. * **Delivery & Title Status:** Verify the actual construction milestone against the RERA timeline, and ensure the land is free from legal litigation.Which micro-markets in Noida are you currently focusing your search on?

turns.q: are all properties in noida leasehold
turns.answer: Yes, virtually all residential properties in Noida are leasehold, operating on a 90 to 99-year lease granted by the Noida Authority.The local authority retains underlying ownership of the land, while buyers own the apartment superstructure and hold a registered tripartite sub-lease deed. Blanket freehold conversion remains deferred under Uttar Pradesh state policy.For buyers, this means verifying authority dues is critical during a purchase. Alongside a Society NDC for maintenance arrears, you must ensure all land dues have been cleared so your sub-lease deed can be registered without hindrance.Are you currently exploring residential options in a specific micro-market like Sector 150 or the Expressway?
